name: roko-kb
description: ROKO Network knowledge base published with Pagenary.

scripts.build: pagenary build:tenants roko-kb && npm run strip:fact-comments
scripts.build:docs: pagenary build:tenants roko-kb && npm run strip:fact-comments
scripts.build:docs:incremental: pagenary build:tenants roko-kb --incremental && npm run strip:fact-comments
scripts.validate:release: npm run validate:docs && npm run validate:migration
scripts.index:aiwg: aiwg index build --force --verbose && aiwg index export --format fortemi --graph project --out /tmp/roko-project-aiwg-fortemi-index.json && npm run validate:aiwg-index
